title: French commissioners at Calais (Duprat) to Francis I, autumn 1521: three 'Mémoires chiffrés', BnF fr. 3092 ff. 101-107 (DECODE R3699-R3701)

steps.what: Repo grep: fr3029/ and fr3029f134/ notes and Tomokiyo's GL.htm list fr. 3092 ff. 101, 103, 107 in Lasry's fr. 3029 cipher; GL.htm prints Lasry's raw decipherment of 'f.100' (edited by Tomokiyo), dated tentatively and suggested as possibly Elizabethan.
DECODE record pages R3699-R3701 fetched with the session cookie; 11 images downloaded (full-resolution leaves P2/P3/P5, openings as .jpeg).
Lasry's table applied to f.101r line 1: 'on ne se devoit glorifier jusques a la fin et que tant de choses', matching Tomokiyo's text; key applies unchanged.

f.101r (26 lines) transcribed by eye from overlapping band crops, each sign as its key letter; ff.103r-104r (65 lines) and f.107r-v (40 lines) given to two transcription subagents with a written brief.
f.101r compared with Tomokiyo's edited text: agrees; his unread '<?>' after 'mal' is two null signs (Ш, slash). 107r18-21 checked sign for sign against the image; 103v10 name sign confirmed as N3.
lang.lm.best_language on the 4,521 letter signs: fr-1600-letters first (-1.93 vs fr-modern -2.12).
BnF inventory of fr. 3092 (cc49555w) fetched: nos. 43/44/46 'Mémoire chiffré' among 1521 Robertet papers (Mouzon, Nassau's army, Villandry at Calais 8 Nov).

All three read: Calais conference 1521 (Wolsey, Gattinara, 'moy chancelier' = Duprat); Albany's secret departure for Scotland; Wolsey's private talk, 'domp Prevost', the Emperor to be sent to Spain. Name signs graded from context with fr. 3029 f.134: N3 = roy, N2 = the Emperor, N1 = King of England?, N4 open.

outcome.notes: All 131 cipher lines read with Lasry's key unchanged; 13 name-sign tokens have no key value (N3 and N2 identified from context, N1 and N4 tentative); dated to the Calais conference, autumn 1521.

gaps.item: name signs N1 (104r09) and N4 (101r19), 2 tokens
gaps.detail: one use each here; identity graded M and I from context; no key or decipherment names them

gaps.item: blotted signs at 103r23 end and 104r09 start
gaps.detail: struck through by the writer; not counted

outcome.fraction_read_source: fr3092/signs.txt: 4,549 signs, 13 name signs without a key value = 4,536/4,549

prior.where: Lasry key table (05/11/2023) and an edited text of f.101r (as 'fr.3092 f.100') on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm; no text of ff.103-104 or f.107 anywhere found
